name: Caffeine / Guarana
warning: High caffeine / guarana content: excessive intake should be limited during pregnancy.

name: Raw / Unpasteurised items
warning: May contain raw or unpasteurised ingredients: risk of bacterial infection (e.g. Listeria).

name: Retinol / Vitamin A high-dose
warning: Contains retinol / high-dose vitamin A: high levels may pose teratogenic risks during pregnancy.

name: St. John's Wort
warning: Contains St. John's Wort: herbal supplement not recommended during pregnancy.

name: Dong Quai
warning: Contains Dong Quai: uterine stimulant herbs are unsafe during pregnancy.
